label: Mass distribution axis (pear <-> big-chest)

provenance.anchors_note: weight multipliers are [E] calibrations chosen to drive the sourced girth-ratio bands in MUSCLE_TISSUE_MODEL.md section 3 (gynoid WHR ~0.70, android WHR >= 0.95); they are tuning values, not measurements

semantics: One control, body.distribution in [-1, +1], steering both vectors. Piecewise-linear weight multipliers over four macro regions, anchored at the five archetypes. Tissue placement takes the factors at full strength (strength_tissue); muscle deposition at reduced strength (strength_muscle) because muscle distribution is partly frame. Factors are emitted as derived values; the regional-tissue coupling consumes the tissue factors, the geometry layer consumes both.
